summary.title: Transactional Email Best Practices
summary.one_liner: A slide deck giving a checklist of transactional email best practices covering sender names, subject lines, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), design, content, subscription management and monitoring.
takeaways: Use a recognizable From name (product or company) and avoid end-user names as the sender name.
Use distinct subject lines and preheaders that add context rather than repeating the subject.
Authenticate sending with SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and separate transactional sending from bulk promotional domains.
Avoid no-reply addresses, include plain-text versions, design for mobile, and use absolute dates.
Provide easy unsubscribe or preference links and monitor open, click, bounce and spam rates.
summary.summary: This Speaker Deck presentation by Wildbit is a condensed checklist adapted from Postmark's transactional email best practices guide. It is organized into sections on From names and addresses, subject lines and preheaders, recipients and replies, authentication and domains, design and formatting, content and purpose, subscription management, and monitoring. Each practice is listed with a short rationale and, where useful, a do-this versus not-this example. The deck gives short explanations rather than deep technical detail, with links to further guides on SPF, DKIM and DMARC.
